messages:
Ava (Product): quick sync — proposing a slimdown MVP for the upcoming launch. goal: preserve core LLM customer journeys, cut lower-value admin/analytics surface, defer tenant SSO to v1/pilot. need alignment on cutlist + canary gating by EOD tomorrow.

Ravi (Eng): sounds reasonable. what are the specific technical risks if we pull admin + analytics? numbers on latency/cost impact?

Ava (Product): high level: removing admin-heavy flows and non-essential background analytics reduces surface area and dev work (~30% dev delta). the main runtime risk is cache & batching complexity — if we narrow caching to chat routes only we keep p95 tight. cost ests attached later but ballpark: ~15% lower infra unit cost.

Lena (Design): admin cut is fine but we should keep a minimal org-onboarding path (org name, billing contact, basic team invite) so trial conversion isn't hurt. propose a single-page minimal org settings.

Samir (SRE): notable runtime tradeoff: dropping prefix/KV caching on background pipelines can bump p95 for mixed traffic by ~50–80ms. mitigation: preserve KV caching for chat and streaming, disable for analytics ingestion routes. also want a staged canary (5%→20%→100%) with automated rollback on latency/eval regressions.

Ravi (Eng): agree on canary. also need a migration plan for customers currently on SSO. do we auto-block or offer a path?

Eve (PM): AcmeHealth flagged SSO as high priority. recommend offering a paid pilot (Dedicated/Private) to meet them while we defer GA SSO to v1. That keeps the sales motion alive without expanding MVP scope.

Ava (Product): decision proposal (MVP slimdown):
- keep: core chat (streaming + history), embeddings read-only endpoints, model pinning for production routes
- minimal: one-page org onboarding (name + billing + invite)
- defer: tenant SSO GA, cross-tenant analytics dashboards, advanced admin reports
- ops: per-route caching toggles, canary rollout policy, rollback playbook

Launch acceptance criteria (proposed):
- p95 token latency for core chat < 250ms under expected load
- no >5% drop in conversion on trial funnel for minimal onboarding (monitor for 2 weeks)
- no quality regressions on curated eval prompt set (automated checks pass)
- cost/unit below internal threshold (approx < $X per 1M tokens)

RolloutsBot: Canary created: mvp-slimdown-2026-03-24 — stages 5% / 20% / 100%, monitoring hooks wired to latency + eval regressions.

Ravi (Eng): I'll draft the cut PRs and feature-flag wiring. plan to freeze the cutlist by tomorrow noon PST. @Lena will you handle the microcopy for the minimal org page?

Lena (Design): yep — microcopy + tiny modal for users on SSO -> explain pilot option. will iterate this afternoon.

Samir (SRE): I'll own canary ops and the rollback runbook. will add per-route feature flags and a smoke test that checks p50/p95 and error budget.

Ava (Product): small config snippet for feature flags we talked about:```yaml
feature_flags:
  slimdown_mvp: true
  caching_chat: true
  caching_analytics: false
```

Eve (PM): I’ll coordinate customer comms for pilots and message Product Council.

Ravi (Eng): no objections from eng. :thumbsup:

Lena (Design): no objections.

Samir (SRE): no objections. I’ll post rollback playbook link once ready.

Ava (Product): OK — unless any objections by noon PST tomorrow, we’ll assume consensus and lock the slimdown cutlist. thanks everyone :shipit:

RolloutsBot: Note: canary warnings will post to #eng-oncall and #product when thresholds exceeded.
